changes.title: ‘Don’t Worry About Me’: Attacker’s Father Thought She Had Turned a Corner
changes.summary: Pamela Cisneros was killed by the police in Times Square after she stabbed two people, one fatally. Her father said she had stopped going with him to her mental health appointments.

changes.title: Victim in Times Square stabbing identified as Bank of America employee Erin Piacenti
changes.summary: Erin Piacenti was identified as one of the two people stabbed by a woman Monday afternoon in Times Square before police shot and killed the suspect.

changes.title: Woman Stabs 2, Killing One, in Times Square and Is Shot Dead by N.Y.P.D.
changes.summary: The police fired at the woman, who was holding two knives, after trying to use less lethal force, officials said. A woman, 32, was killed, and a man, 68, is in stable condition.

changes.title: Woman killed in Times Square stabbing attack worked for Bank of America
changes.summary: The woman who died, Erin Piacenti, 32, was one of two people who were stabbed Monday afternoon in the tourist and theater hub, a few blocks from Bank of America's office tower in New York.
